output.question: Where can I find Bank of America's latest annual report?
output.answer: The latest is Bank of America's 2025 Annual Report, which you can get from the Annual Reports & Proxy Statements page of its Investor Relations site (investor.bankofamerica.com/annual-reports-and-proxy-statements). That page links to a PDF of the report and to the 2026 Proxy Statement. The company announced on March 30, 2026 that the report was out. It includes a letter from Chair and CEO Brian Moynihan and sections on each of the company's eight lines of business.

key_facts.fact: The Annual Reports & Proxy Statements page on Bank of America's Investor Relations site lists the 2025 Annual Report as its most recent annual report, with a PDF link: https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_299021e6298435f69aca9ed18a91ea2d/bankofamerica/db/867/10497/annual_report/BAC+2025+Annual+Report.pdf
The 2026 Proxy Statement and the 2026 Additional Solicitation Materials are on the same page.
Bank of America announced the 2025 Annual Report and 2026 Proxy Statement on March 30, 2026. The announcement also gives a direct link to the report: investor.bankofamerica.com/2025-annual-report.
The report includes a letter from Chair and CEO Brian Moynihan, sections on the company's eight lines of business and an update on human capital management.

passages.quote: The 2025 Bank of America Annual Report and 2026 Proxy Statement are now available for viewing on our Investor Relations site.

caveats: The 2025 Annual Report covers fiscal year 2025, which ended December 31, 2025. The 2026 report will probably come out around March or April 2027.

A Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025 shows up in search results with a filing date of 2026-02-25, but I didn't open the 10-K or the SEC filing page to confirm it. The IR site has it under Regulatory & Other Filings > Select SEC Filings, and it is also on SEC EDGAR.
A search summary said the IR homepage might still label its annual report link as 2024. The Annual Reports & Proxy Statements page itself shows 2025 as the latest.
